finding.impact: Provenance assertions and reported program_count are not authenticated by label replay; Racket label correctness remained intact.
finding.required_regression: Reject stale or forged program digest and exact source mapping after private manifest digest is recomputed.
finding.summary: A correctly labeled export with rehashed private bytes can carry false program and source digests and still verify as passed.

limits: Bounded review only; not a proof of all possible inputs or all candidate programs.
Seed and input_seed remain descriptive metadata, not certificate authority.
No prototype, existing tests, RESULTS, immutable generator or canonical rules edited by reviewer.
One-demonstration seed 701 left episode correctly refused an ambiguous all_gray:left query; not classified as a defect.
scope: sampler counts, finite support, exact integer bounds, common direction grammar
public/private serialization, verifier rejection and source provenance
static_observations: Candidate elimination iterates demonstrations only; query labels are subsequently verified and cannot resurrect candidates.
Saved certificates are recomputed; export verification compares stored and recomputed certificates.
